questions.question: Which traversal technique is used to visit each node of a linked list exactly once?
questions.explanation: A linked list is traversed linearly from the head following next pointers, visiting each node once. Preorder, inorder and postorder are tree traversals.

questions.question: The brain of any computer is
questions.explanation: The CPU is called the brain of the computer because it executes instructions and controls all units. The ALU and CU are only parts of the CPU.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a subnet mask in TCP/IP networking?

options.A: To identify the network portion of an IP address
options.B: To identify the host portion of an IP address
options.C: To convert IP addresses into domain names
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A subnet mask marks which bits of an IP address belong to the network (subnet) portion. Converting names to IP addresses is done by DNS.

questions.question: "Ctrl + End" is used to

options.A: move the cursor to the end of line
options.B: move the cursor to the end of document
options.C: move the cursor to the end of paragraph

questions.explanation: Ctrl+End moves the cursor to the end of the document. End alone moves to the end of the line.

questions.question: Which of the following highly uses the concept of an array?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Array elements are stored in contiguous memory, so accessing them exploits spatial locality of reference. BSTs and process scheduling typically rely on linked structures and queues.

questions.question: In which menu can you find features like Slide Design, Slide Layout etc.?
questions.explanation: In PowerPoint 2003, Slide Design and Slide Layout are found in the Format menu.

questions.question: Integrated Circuits (ICs) are related to which generation of computers?
questions.explanation: Third generation computers (1964-1971) used integrated circuits. Fourth generation used microprocessors (VLSI).

questions.question: Communication channel is shared by all the machines on the network in
questions.explanation: In a broadcast network a single communication channel is shared by all machines; a packet sent by one is received by all.

questions.question: Which of the following satisfies the property of the red-black tree?

options.A: Black, if the new node is a root node
options.B: Red, if the new node is not a root node
options.C: Black, if the new node is not a root node
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: In a red-black tree the root is always black, and a newly inserted non-root node is coloured red. Both A and B are true, so the answer is 'More than one of the above'.

questions.question: Which of the following is not an example of DBMS?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Microsoft Access and IBM Db2 are DBMS software. Google is a search engine/company, not a DBMS.

questions.question: Which of the following is correct for Digital Circuits?

options.A: They use analog signals for communication
options.B: They process information using continuous voltage levels
options.C: They are not suitable for high speed operations

questions.explanation: Digital circuits use discrete (binary) signals, not analog or continuous voltage levels, and they are well suited to high-speed operation. Since A, B and C are all false, the answer is None of the above.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. It is not possible to combine two or more file opening modes in open() method.
2. It is possible to combine two or more file opening modes in open() method.
3. ios::in and ios::out are input and output file opening modes respectively.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: File modes can be combined with the bitwise OR operator, e.g. ios::in | ios::out, so statement 2 is true and 1 is false; statement 3 is also true.

questions.question: In audio and video compression, each frame is divided into small grids, called picture elements or ________.
questions.explanation: Each video frame is a grid of picture elements, called pixels. Mega pixel is a unit of a million pixels, not the name of a single element.

questions.question: The term "multi-user" in an OS context refers to:

options.A: An OS that can execute multiple programs simultaneously
options.B: An OS that supports multiple users working on the same machine
options.C: An OS that can only run on multiple computers
options.D: An OS with a graphical user interface

questions.explanation: A multi-user OS allows multiple users to use the same computer's resources at the same time. Executing multiple programs is multitasking/multiprogramming.

questions.question:
The question below is an Assertion (A) and Reason (R) based question. Mark the correct choice.
Assertion (A): We can retrieve records from more than one table in MySQL.
Reason (R): Foreign key is used to establish a relationship between two tables.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation for Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is not the correct explanation for Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false but Reason (R) is true.

questions.explanation: Both are true: records from multiple tables can be retrieved with joins or Cartesian products, and a foreign key links two tables. But multi-table retrieval does not depend on a foreign key, so R does not explain A.

questions.question: "Ctrl + Down Arrow" is used to

options.A: move the cursor one paragraph down
options.B: move the cursor one line down
options.C: move the cursor one page down
options.D: move the cursor one screen down

questions.explanation: Ctrl+Down Arrow moves the cursor to the beginning of the next paragraph. The Down Arrow alone moves one line down.

questions.question: Maximum read range of RFID module is?
questions.explanation: The common RC522 13.56 MHz RFID reader module used in IoT projects has a maximum read range of about 5 cm.

questions.question: Turing machine can be represented using:
questions.explanation: A Turing machine can be described by a transition table, by a transition diagram, and its configurations by instantaneous descriptions. All three are valid representations.

questions.question: In a threaded binary tree, the space required for threads is usually:

options.A: Greater than the space required for regular pointers
options.B: Equal to the space required for regular pointers
options.C: Less than the space required for regular pointers

questions.explanation: Threads reuse the otherwise null left/right pointer fields, so they need no extra pointer storage; only small tag bits are added. Hence the space for threads is less than that for regular pointers.

questions.question: What is the main advantage of using exception handling in programming?

options.C: It handles unexpected errors and allows graceful program termination
options.D: It eliminates the need for classes and objects

questions.explanation: Exception handling lets a program catch unexpected runtime errors and respond gracefully (recover or terminate cleanly) instead of crashing abruptly.

questions.question: Stealing someone's intellectual work and representing it as your own is known as:
questions.explanation: Plagiarism is presenting someone else's ideas or work as one's own. Identity theft is stealing personal identity details, not intellectual work.

questions.question: Microprocessors as switching devices are for which generation computers
questions.explanation: Fourth generation computers (1971 onwards) used VLSI microprocessors. Third generation used ICs, second transistors, first vacuum tubes.

questions.question: Software engineering emerged due to:

options.B: The need for complex hardware systems
options.C: The challenges posed by software development

questions.explanation: Software engineering emerged as a response to the software crisis: late, over-budget and unreliable software. It was not caused by declining technology or a hardware focus.

questions.question: Boolean algebra can be used

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Boolean algebra is used for designing digital computers and in (switching) circuit theory, and it underlies logic symbols as well. Since more than one option is correct, the answer is D.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of data compression in data communication?
questions.explanation: Compression reduces the number of bits sent, so it reduces bandwidth usage and transmission time. It does not aim to increase latency, and it is not an error-control or security technique.
